name: Puja Juneja
body: We went to a sangeet at Palace Grounds themed Under the Stars, and it was stunning. The decor was all sparkling lights and, for a change, no flowers, which was a pleasant surprise. Chelna created a starry sky even in a closed space.
The dance floor glimmered with fairy lights and crystal droplets, and chandeliers and lamps lit the greenery around it. Only Chelna could create magic like that.
excerpt: The dance floor glimmered with fairy lights and crystal droplets, and chandeliers and lamps lit the greenery around it. Only Chelna could create magic like that.

name: Kashish Nandwani
body: Chelna Lekhi is the best planner I have had the luck to work with. She made my dreams come true and gave me the perfect fairytale prom night. From the Rustic Romance themed backdrop to the dessert cart, my prom was exactly how I had imagined it. Thank you for putting it together so elegantly. I would wholeheartedly recommend Soul Events India.
excerpt: She made my dreams come true and gave me the perfect fairytale prom night. From the Rustic Romance themed backdrop to the dessert cart, my prom was exactly how I had imagined it.

name: Freesia Wadia
body: When we got engaged last year, my mother mentioned that an old friend of hers, Chelna, was an event planner. I had met Chelna in my late teens and, as teenagers do, I had paid very little attention to my mother's friends at the time.

Chelna and Ramesh exceeded every expectation for our wedding and reception. All we had to do was show them a few inspiration pictures and tell them our colour themes. I snuck in to see our mandap in the early hours of the morning and was taken away. It was the most beautiful design I had seen, and exactly how I had pictured it. For the evening reception they asked me not to look beforehand, because they wanted to see my husband's face and mine as we walked in. I was overwhelmed by what they created for us. I honestly do not think anyone else could have pulled off what those two did.

Ramesh and Chelna answered every question, kept us calm, and kept us happy throughout. It was a blessing to work with them, and we hope to work with them again for our next big event, whenever that may be. We could never thank them enough, and we will always be grateful.
excerpt: I snuck in to see our mandap in the early hours of the morning and was taken away. It was the most beautiful design I had seen, and exactly how I had pictured it.

name: Prakriti Nakul
body: I threw a bridal shower for my sister-in-law and Chelna made it look stunning. The decor was beautiful, elegant, and just perfect. She has wonderful ideas and is clearly passionate about her work. She handles absolutely everything, and you simply walk into a gorgeous setup. I hope to do many more events with her.
excerpt: She handles absolutely everything, and you simply walk into a gorgeous setup. I hope to do many more events with her.

name: Kavya Vinod
body: I could not have asked for a better experience than working with Chelna on my baby shower decor. Through a fortunate turn of events I only heard about her company a week before the shower, and thank goodness I did.

She was incredibly easy to work with, bringing a perfect balance of creativity and professionalism. She executed exactly what I had envisioned, and more, within the budget I had. Her ideas were fantastic and she made sure every detail matched what I had in mind. Despite several last-minute hurdles, she handled everything effortlessly and brought it all together beautifully. I am so grateful for her dedication and talent in making my baby shower extra special.
excerpt: She executed exactly what I had envisioned, and more, within the budget I had. Her ideas were fantastic and she made sure every detail matched what I had in mind.

name: Manjari Somani
body: Chelna was the only person I thought of when I wanted someone to dress up my spring and summer Joie de Vivre brunch, and I was exactly right. From a simple brief she got straight into the theme, and the results were stunning.

Every centre table arrangement was different, and unique in its own way, built around orange flora and fauna. When I asked her about it afterwards, she showed me pages and pages of research printouts she had worked through to get there. Working with Chelna was a breeze. I did nothing at all except show up. Her efficiency, her attention to detail, and how hands on she is are what I took away from my first experience with her.
excerpt: Every centre table arrangement was different, and unique in its own way, built around orange flora and fauna.

name: Jhumki Agarwal
body: Dear Chelna, there are so many things I want to thank you and Ramesh for. Ten years after you did my brother's wedding, you were the only ones I wanted for mine.

Besides a fabulous job on the decor and the planning across all three days, your thoughtful small gestures meant so much. Thank you for making sure every one of my demands was met, which was vital. We were involved at every stage of the planning, and I think we learned to be methodical from you. You truly stand by the name Soul Events, because you did my wedding from the very bottom of your heart.
excerpt: You truly stand by the name Soul Events, because you did my wedding from the very bottom of your heart.

name: Shweta Jain
body: Working with Chelna has been nothing short of exceptional. She recently helped us plan and execute my husband's 50th birthday celebration and, once again, she exceeded all expectations. From the earliest planning stages to the very last detail on the night, her dedication, creativity, and professionalism came through.

What truly sets Chelna apart is not just her talent for organising beautiful, seamless events. It is her genuine commitment as a person. She takes the time to understand our vision, our priorities, and even the personalities involved, which makes each event feel personal, thoughtful, and memorable. She is also my go to person when I need to pull off a party at the last minute: reliable, resourceful, and always calm under pressure.

This was not the first time we have worked with her, and it certainly will not be the last. She has helped us organise several important occasions over the years, and every time she delivers with warmth, grace, and an incredible eye for detail. Knowing she is in charge lets us relax and enjoy the moment, which is the greatest gift of all.
excerpt: Knowing she is in charge lets us relax and enjoy the moment, which is the greatest gift of all.

name: Charu Mathur
body: We recently had the joy of celebrating two very special occasions together: my mother-in-law's 80th birthday and my niece's 9th, born just a day apart. We wanted the celebration to feel fun, warm, and truly memorable.

What started as an idea for a high tea turned into something magical, thanks to Chelna and her team. Their decor brought the whole vision to life, from the beautiful flower arrangements to the smallest details of ladybirds, English curios, and butterflies. One of the highlights was the Mills and Boon corner Chelna thoughtfully set up for my mother-in-law, who loves reading them to this day, and she was absolutely thrilled by it.

What I appreciate most about Chelna and her team is how personally they took on this celebration, as though it were their own family's. We now carry with us a celebration filled with love, laughter, and beautiful memories.
excerpt: One of the highlights was the Mills and Boon corner Chelna thoughtfully set up for my mother-in-law, who loves reading them to this day, and she was absolutely thrilled by it.

name: Srishti Golecha
body: I can still feel the energy from 19th September, the day Shubham and I got engaged. It was a wonderful success, and that is in great part down to Chelna and Ramesh.

Thank you to a dream team for making our engagement so memorable, for the detailed touches in the decor, and for hosting such a great evening for all of us. To all the brides and grooms to be, we would highly recommend Chelna and Ramesh.
excerpt: Thank you to a dream team for making our engagement so memorable, for the detailed touches in the decor, and for hosting such a great evening for all of us.

name: Ikshita Tewari
body: I wanted to thank you for such an amazing execution of the entire decor. It was just fabulous, and every detail turned out exactly as I had imagined. The duck theme was a hit and she was so happy to see all the ducks. I had to hide the duck stuffies from her because she wanted to take every one of them home. An absolutely amazing team, and beautifully done.
excerpt: The duck theme was a hit and she was so happy to see all the ducks. I had to hide the duck stuffies from her because she wanted to take every one of them home.

name: Dr Deepthi
body: Dear Ramesh and Chelna, the event management for the St John's DJ celebrations was fabulous. You and your team did wonders. The auditorium looked like the bride and the food court the bridesmaid, and at night it looked like a fairyland.

The pastel colours Chelna chose, with the fresh flower theme and the dazzling lights, made it no less than a royal programme. In my twenty-two years at St John's, I have never seen our auditorium decorated like this.

Hats off to your professionalism, your planning, your eye for every detail, and the calm you kept through constantly changing plans. You both addressed every need of ours patiently and politely, and I loved that attitude. I wish you the very best, and I look forward to working with you on events like this in future. Most important of all, I have gained by knowing two very nice people.
excerpt: The auditorium looked like the bride and the food court the bridesmaid, and at night it looked like a fairyland.

name: Sanjeev Atmaram
body: The effort Chelna put in and the outcome were both spectacular. The meticulous, detailed insight into every aspect was visible. We truly appreciate the result: the decor, the sound, and every part of the mega show.
excerpt: The effort Chelna put in and the outcome were both spectacular. The meticulous, detailed insight into every aspect was visible.

name: Mable Roy
body: Chelna's contribution to our Diwali and Christmas celebrations was truly commendable. She planned and beautifully executed the decorations, creating a warm and festive atmosphere for everyone.

What stood out most was her conscious effort to keep the decorations environmentally friendly and thoughtfully reused, reflecting a strong sense of responsibility and sustainability. Her attention to detail, creativity, and willingness to go the extra mile made both celebrations memorable. We are sincerely grateful to Chelna for her dedication and her impact.
excerpt: What stood out most was her conscious effort to keep the decorations environmentally friendly and thoughtfully reused, reflecting a strong sense of responsibility and sustainability.
